messages.subject: inla.read.graph failure
parts:
Dear INLA group,

I would like to load a large graph file about 20M through "inla.read.graph", but INLA seems crashed.
My PC has 16G ram and Win10 system.
Is there another way to read the graph file?

Thanks in advance

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.read.graph failure
parts:
it shouldn't be a problem but if your model is large and you're running
windows you might experience trouble because of that. It has been
reported that even runnig a Linux virtual machine within Windows,
enable larger models to be run than in Windows itself. Don't ask me
why, as I'm not into Windows.

H
